title: Higher-Cell Product Retractions, Simplicial Cochains, and Finite Retraction Dynamics
description: A finite study of product-of-marginals retraction and its oblique tangent projector, distinguished from highest-order tensor components and nearest-product trace distance. Closed-system and finite-dilation Taylor estimates use declared norm and site budgets. Six written-only lemmas add finite-jump and mixed Hamiltonian/jump bounds, fixed finite autonomous dilation counterexamples, and a state-acceleration cross-term witness. Nonzero correlation distance alone does not imply entanglement; the two-qubit distance-greater-than-one criterion is attributed to Hall. Scalar Hodge and graded-square examples remain separate from the state-local semigroup coefficient; no quantum-to-cochain dynamics bridge is established. Thirteen ledger claims are mapped separately to numerical examples, six written-only lemmas, and seven stored conditional abstract Lean declarations. Fresh pinned Lean and native Jupyter replay remain pending; no Zenodo deposit is asserted.
